page_title: Kissable | Best AI Companion Who Remembers Everything

sources.entry: Kissable - AI companion with persistent memory, together photos, video generation, community scenario catalog, emotional voice, and unlimited messages. #freemium

summary.name: Kissable
summary.one_liner: Kissable is an AI companion app (girlfriend, boyfriend, or friend persona) that stores long-term memory of your conversations, sends photos and voice messages, and is listed as freemium.
keywords: talk to ai late at night
use_cases: Daily chatting with an AI companion that recalls past conversations
Roleplaying shared scenarios and stories with a persona
Late-night conversation when you want someone to talk to
Getting honest feedback from a non-agreeable chat partner
Keeping several separate companions with their own histories
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI companion app where the persona remembers details the user shares and brings them up in later conversations, with no reset between sessions. Users can create multiple companions, each keeping its own history. Companions can send generated photos described as real photos from situations the user describes, plus voice messages. The page also mentions a catalog of shared scenarios the user can step into, and says that voice and couple photos unlock as the relationship deepens. Companions are said to sync across iOS, Android, and web when the user signs in.
notable: Persistent memory of user conversations across sessions
Multiple companions, each with its own story and history
Generated photos and voice messages, with couple photos and voice unlocking as bond grows
Scenario catalog for roleplay, with a companion that remembers them
caveats: Free messages and Kisses are offered to start; the page does not detail paid tier limits
Rated 4.6 on the App Store from 290+ ratings, per the page
Some features such as voice and couple photos are gated behind relationship progress
